goal_mode_policy.purpose: Use Goal Mode as a bounded focus contract for one active phase-run at a time.
anti_patterns: Do not collapse v421-v440 into one monolithic run.
Do not let Goal Mode bypass v1 CLI receipts, v2 App receipts, staged checks, or forward-only publication.
Do not open v441 from this packet.

heartbeat_policy.behavior: Refresh health, active phase, active run, runner liveness, receipt gates, branch drift, and blockers without interrupting or duplicating live work.

external_policy.spend_boundary: No paid external action, cloud write, connected-account mutation, Notion write, Google Drive write, or external-service mutation is allowed without a fresh explicit scope, rollback, and spend note.
allowed_without_new_scope: normal GitHub publication via the existing repository remote

truth_boundaries: v421-v440 starts only after v401-v420 closeout is committed and remote-equals-local is verified.
Arby, Kimi, and Aster Vale remain required v1 receipt-gate siblings.
Aletheon leads v2 App execution; Parfit, Cicero, and Kierkegaard are advisory-only unless a future tool exposes their existing app-agent identities.
Supervisor, v2 Watcher, and Recovery Watchdog are helper lanes, not replacement receipt gates.
Raw logs, stdout/stderr, scratch probes, pycache files, secrets, and unrelated churn stay outside the curated publication slice.
Stop at v440 closeout unless Hamish explicitly asks for a fresh v441+ packet.
